mapper.update:
UPDATE PLAN_TABLE
PLAN_TITLE = #{planTitle}, END_TO = #{endTo},
REPEAT_DAYS = #{repeatDays, typeHandler=com.godLife.project.handler.typehandler.ListStringTypeHandler},
TARGET_IDX = #{targetIdx}, JOB_IDX = #{jobIdx}, PLAN_IMP = #{planImp}, IS_SHARED = #{isShared}, DESCRIPTION = #{description}, COLOR = #{color}, PLAN_SUB_MOD = NOW()
WHERE PLAN_IDX = #{planIdx} AND USER_IDX = #{userIdx}
UPDATE PLAN_TABLE SET IS_DELETED = 1, IS_ACTIVE = 0, IS_COMPLETED = 0, PLAN_SUB_START = NULL, PLAN_SUB_END = NULL WHERE PLAN_IDX = #{planIdx} AND USER_IDX = #{userIdx}

UPDATE PLAN_ACTIVITY
ACTIVITY_NAME = #{activityName}, ACTIVITY_IMP = #{activityImp}, EVENT = #{event}, DURATION = #{duration},
SET_TIME = #{setTime},
WHERE PLAN_IDX = #{planIdx} AND ACTIVITY_IDX = #{activityIdx} AND IS_DELETED = 0
mapper.select: SELECT A.ACTIVITY_IDX, A.PLAN_IDX, A.ACTIVITY_NAME, A.SET_TIME, A.ACTIVITY_IMP, A.EVENT, A.DURATION, COALESCE(V.VERIFIED, 0) AS VERIFIED FROM PLAN_ACTIVITY A LEFT JOIN ( SELECT V.ACTIVITY_IDX, COUNT(V.ACTIVITY_IDX) AS VERIFIED FROM VERIFY_TABLE V WHERE V.VERIFY_DATE = CURDATE() GROUP BY V.ACTIVITY_IDX ) V ON A.ACTIVITY_IDX = V.ACTIVITY_IDX WHERE A.PLAN_IDX = #{planIdx} AND A.IS_DELETED = 0 ORDER BY A.ACTIVITY_IMP DESC, A.ACTIVITY_IDX ASC
